high.title: Prabowo Reveals New Gold Reserves Discovered in Papua: 'Our Future is Very Bright'
high.summary: President Prabowo announced that a scientific expedition by BRIN (National Research and Innovation Agency) and the Indonesian military (TNI) has discovered significant gold and mineral reserves in the mountains of Papua. This discovery could have major implications for Indonesia's mining sector, foreign investment in resource extraction, and long-term economic outlook. Investors in mining and commodity-related equities should monitor this development closely as further details on reserve size and development plans emerge.

high.title: Prabowo Launches B50 Biodiesel Mandate, Defends Food Self-Sufficiency Claims Against Critics
high.summary: President Prabowo officially launched the B50 biodiesel mandate at the Jakarta-Cikampek Toll Road Rest Area KM57, a significant policy milestone for Indonesia's energy and agricultural sectors. He also strongly pushed back against critics who accuse the government of fabricating food self-sufficiency achievements, asserting that the government would not lie to the public. The B50 mandate has major implications for palm oil demand, the biofuel industry, and energy import dependency, making it a critical development for investors in energy, agriculture, and related commodities.

high.title: Indonesia Officially Launches B50 Biodiesel Mandate
high.summary: President Prabowo revealed that a scientific expedition by BRIN and TNI has discovered significant new gold and mineral reserves in the Papua highlands, just weeks into the expedition. This discovery could have major long-term implications for Indonesia's mining sector and resource-based revenues, potentially attracting significant investor interest in Papua-related assets.

high.title: Indonesia's Carbon Trading Market Remains Tiny at Only IDR 93.81 Billion — New SRUK Platform Launched to Boost Activity
high.summary: OJK Chairwoman Friderica Widyasari Dewi announced the launch of the new carbon trading platform SRUK (Sistem Registrasi Unit Karbon), aiming to expand Indonesia's underdeveloped carbon market. Since the IDXCarbon exchange launched, cumulative transactions have reached only 1.98 million tons CO2e worth IDR 93.81 billion across 431 transactions and 155 registered users. The new platform is expected to significantly scale up carbon market participation, opening new investment and compliance opportunities for businesses.

high.title: JCI Plunged Nearly 8% in June, Foreign Capital Outflow Reaches IDR 19.63 Trillion
high.summary: OJK (Financial Services Authority) reported that Indonesia's stock market remains heavily influenced by global uncertainty, with the JCI (Jakarta Composite Index) weakening throughout June 2026. OJK's Capital Market Supervisory Executive Head Hasan Fawzi stated the market is in a consolidation phase, driven by investor perceptions of domestic policies and portfolio rebalancing. The significant foreign capital outflow of IDR 19.63 trillion signals continued pressure on the Indonesian equity market.

medium.title: KPK Leadership Visits Finance Minister Purbaya to Discuss Budget Proposals for 2026-2027
medium.summary: The Corruption Eradication Commission (KPK) leadership, including Chairman Setyo Budiyanto and deputy chairpersons, met with Finance Minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa at the Ministry of Finance to discuss additional budget allocations for fiscal years 2026 and 2027. The meeting was confirmed to be strictly about budgetary matters and did not involve any legal cases or other programs. This signals ongoing budget negotiation processes that could affect overall state expenditure planning.

medium.title: Prabowo Reports Farmers' Purchasing Power Rising Significantly, with Motorcycle and Car Purchases Up Tens of Percent
medium.summary: President Prabowo cited reports from multiple provinces indicating that farmers' incomes have risen substantially, with motorcycle and car purchases increasing by tens of percent. Additional indicators cited include higher livestock slaughter during Eid al-Adha and increased umrah pilgrimages among farmers, suggesting improved rural purchasing power. This data, if verified, would be positive for consumer discretionary sectors, automotive companies, and rural-focused financial services.

medium.title: Entering Year Six: Cashless Toll Payment System (MLFF) Still Not Implemented — What's Going On?
medium.summary: Indonesia's Multi Lane Free Flow (MLFF) toll payment system, signed with PT Roatex Indonesia Toll System (RITS) in March 2021, has still not been fully implemented despite entering its sixth year. The Toll Road Regulatory Agency (BPJT) is preparing for another pilot test in 2026 following a limited trial at Bali Mandara Toll Road in December 2023. Continued delays in this infrastructure technology project raise concerns about implementation capacity and could affect investor confidence in related technology and infrastructure concessions.

medium.title: Government Plans Toll Road Discount During June-July 2025 School Holiday Period
medium.summary: The Indonesian government is planning toll road fare discounts during the June-July 2025 school holiday period, targeting approximately 110 million motorists. The Indonesian Toll Road Association (ATI) noted that all tariff policies, including discounts, are under the authority of the Toll Road Regulatory Agency (BPJT) under the Ministry of Public Works. This is unusual as such discounts have historically only been granted during major holidays like Lebaran or Christmas/New Year to ease congestion.

medium.title: Here Is Why Toll Road Tariffs Frequently Increase, According to ATI
medium.summary: The Indonesian Toll Road Association (ATI) has disclosed that toll tariff increases are driven by the need to recover massive construction investments, not profit-seeking. Construction costs per kilometer of toll road currently range from IDR 200–400 billion depending on design type, funded through equity or bank loans. This context is important for investors in toll road operators and related infrastructure stocks listed on the Indonesian Stock Exchange.

medium.title: Overloaded Trucks on Toll Roads Reach Alarming Levels, Data Shows
medium.summary: Violations by over-dimension and over-loading (ODOL) trucks on Indonesian toll roads have reached critical levels, with more than 21% of non-class-I vehicles on Trans-Sumatra Toll roads flagged for violations based on Weigh in Motion (WIM) data in 2025. On Jasa Marga-managed toll roads, the violation rate stands at 17.62%. This poses a serious threat to infrastructure sustainability, raising maintenance costs and accident risks, with direct implications for toll road operators' financial performance.

medium.title: Entering Year Six, Stopless Toll Payment System (MLFF) Still Not Implemented
medium.summary: Indonesia's Multi Lane Free Flow (MLFF) cashless toll payment system remains unimplemented six years after the cooperation agreement was signed with PT Roatex Indonesia Toll System (RITS) in March 2021. The Toll Road Regulatory Agency (BPJT) is currently preparing a new pilot test, following a limited trial at Bali Mandara Toll Road in December 2023. Continued delays in MLFF rollout represent an ongoing regulatory and operational risk for toll road operators and technology vendors involved in the project.

medium.title: President Prabowo Claims Food Self-Sufficiency Achieved, Dismisses Critics as Liars
medium.summary: President Prabowo pushed back against critics who have accused the government of fabricating food self-sufficiency (swasembada pangan) claims, stating the government would never lie to the public. The remarks were made at the launch of the B50 biodiesel mandate, signaling the government's continued emphasis on agricultural and energy self-reliance as key policy pillars. Investor sentiment in the agribusiness and food sector may be influenced by the government's assertive stance on domestic production targets.

medium.title: President Prabowo Reports Significant Rise in Farmer Purchasing Power — Vehicle and Pilgrimage Spending Up Dozens of Percent
medium.summary: President Prabowo cited reports from multiple provinces showing that farmers' incomes are rising substantially, with motorcycle and car purchases up by tens of percent and more farmers performing Umrah pilgrimages. These indicators, if accurate, suggest improving rural consumer spending that could benefit the automotive, FMCG, and financial services sectors. However, the claims are based on informal reports and have not been independently verified, warranting caution from investors.

medium.title: KPK Leadership Visits Finance Minister Purbaya to Discuss 2026–2027 Budget Allocation
medium.summary: KPK Chairman Setyo Budiyanto and senior KPK officials met with Finance Minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa at the Ministry of Finance to discuss budget requests for fiscal years 2026 and 2027. Officials confirmed the meeting was strictly about budget allocations and did not involve any legal cases or other programs. The visit highlights ongoing budget negotiation dynamics within the government, relevant for investors tracking public expenditure priorities.

medium.title: After Touching Red Zone, JCI Closes Higher at 5,900 Level
medium.summary: The Jakarta Composite Index (JCI) recovered from early session losses to close at 5,912, gaining 39 points (0.67%) on Thursday, July 9, 2026. The index had opened in the red at 5,865 before reversing course, with trading volume reaching IDR 12 trillion across 27.07 billion shares. The recovery signals some short-term resilience despite the broader consolidation trend observed in recent weeks.

medium.title: Indonesia Stock Exchange Opens Option to Revise IPO Target Amid Thin Pipeline
medium.summary: The Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX) is considering revising its 2026 IPO target of 50 new listings, as only six companies have gone public so far this year. IDX Director of Company Evaluation Saidu Solihin acknowledged ongoing discussions about whether to lower the target, though no decision has been made yet. The weak IPO pipeline reflects broader market uncertainty and could indicate reduced investor appetite for new listings in the current environment.
